# Best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Hobart

For a Hobart business looking for a reputable Microsoft Power Platform consultant, I’d start with a mix of **local Microsoft specialists and established Australian Power Platform partners that can deliver remotely or on-site in Tasmania**\.

The important distinction is between a general IT provider that supports Microsoft 365 and a specialist that can design, build and govern Power Apps, Power Automate workflows, Dataverse solutions and Power BI reporting.

Here’s my shortlist, based on publicly available service information, local presence, relevant Microsoft expertise and evidence of delivery. It’s a practical shortlist rather than a definitive ranking of every consultant in Tasmania.

## Shortlist: who I’d contact first

![Dynamics 365 - Rapid Circle](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tul-2izpQmBPVXe3c2BCWGtQsZw7vfvsNhIfBpuAsyZ1NMCJEjolyccwGtqovvrh75_vGToSRt72Nm56L8cgok9s8RxOKyawTDVinOROf9ha9dU9u4sQ1MDIdWGx4Y4xNd6xuuj5nN1rWBQ8CAUb9jEaEiOFwIExXD9zALL2TfP39Kr2YWNsmmjc1wI4oAxz?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. UXC Eclipse

Best for established Microsoft business applications projects

UXC Eclipse has a Hobart office and a strong association with Microsoft business applications, particularly Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. It is worth approaching for projects that connect apps and automation with existing enterprise systems, or need implementation and ongoing support.

**Why shortlist it\:** local presence, Microsoft ecosystem experience and a fit for more complex business applications work.

**Check first\:** which Power Platform specialists are currently available in Tasmania and whether they have delivered projects similar to yours.

Hobart · +61 3 6235 2222

---

![Custom Software & App Development for Modern Businesses | ISW](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gK6gZt8HqsD_B5eBEepGGVhXXe0lQHv86Wda0257We83q_p6fK1Vh3NIjeCBgfDGfpGIoyytGzkO1Ko1wKPZOndzBMfVqAMz6N7AB34rp6hjEMUZ4G9WbGSqunMzzG0giGIZLGedEMhUMXXm1rxGHWpqnwePg6FC_t27mhq5G5bS5PE2Rtq7UDi9VhqxUhw2?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. ISW

Best for local delivery and Microsoft technology integration

ISW is an Australian IT and software engineering company headquartered in Battery Point, Hobart. Its Microsoft-related services include workplace technologies, SharePoint and Power Platform, making it a useful candidate for applications and workflow automation that need to fit into your existing IT environment.

**Why shortlist it\:** a genuine Hobart base, broader software engineering capability and relevant Microsoft platform services.

**Check first\:** its current depth in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and enterprise governance for your particular requirements.

Battery Point · 1300 850 479

![Microsoft Power Platform Consulting | Professional Advantage Australia](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/48XBtHrA5K7KWOlgdQDeQUYV1XDG6Ir90ws6EprENn1_xGY6MltphUfvmSw1pWOY3k_H3jretBd6kxQwZmhTqt_IuUieQMJeHf89bqmp1oxX5fcQmsbkjiiOpqGo3HUkN1AEhDmmoaLrxhaPbmiDRoceQ3_izpZyyMTKC_Y9B4NVmI8KXMHn52HPgyQcmvx9?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Power Platform Experts

Best for dedicated Power Platform development and support

This specialist provider explicitly offers Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and Power Pages services, including custom development, deployment, training and ongoing support. Its website includes client testimonials describing responsiveness and help with post-delivery issues. **Why shortlist it\:** its focus is directly aligned with Power Platform rather than general IT support, and remote delivery makes it a candidate for Tasmanian organisations.

**Check first\:** who would actually deliver your project, their relevant certifications, and whether on-site Hobart workshops are available.

## 4\. Barhead Solutions

Barhead has a documented history of delivering Power Platform workshops in Hobart, including a 2021 session for the Tasmanian Government covering apps, automation, chatbots and reporting. That is relevant local delivery evidence, although it does not establish its current Hobart staffing. [barhead.com](https://barhead.com/20210601-teams-and-power-platform-in-a-day/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 5\. Professional Advantage

Best for business-wide implementations, adoption and licensing

Professional Advantage offers Power Apps consulting and describes implementation, change management, licensing advice and integration with Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365. Its published case studies include workflow and process improvements using Power Platform. [www.pa.com.au](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-power-platform/microsoft-power-apps/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why shortlist it\:** a good candidate when the work extends beyond building an app to include user adoption, Microsoft licensing and integration with existing business systems.

**Check first\:** the proposed delivery team, Tasmania coverage and the scale and cost of the engagement.

[pa.com.au](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-power-platform/microsoft-power-apps/)

## One additional local specialist worth checking

![Smarter Starts Here: CoPilot Studio For Real-World AI Wins](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jvMWAd-iEqQPW8ssWburaJTtwt-WuRCF5mI4zbFVtQa4ssYHbBSnd5CLdzNo0wuN0ZeTUpm-wLBt8F-zjCSsi38lvowppPO5jzkuI601vn77NsG6zCoC83iRQFeEmyXcelvg2NePVShDlXuOZuOvSwUmri0w5r31wO2-4rsmA2VvYINGzUNFfANQW66uv_Co?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. Tasmanian Business FutureAbility**

Best for locally focused Power Platform and AI automation

TasICT's service directory describes FutureAbility as a Hobart-based Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio specialist, building automated workflows and AI agents within customers' own Microsoft tenants. [www.tasict.com.au](https://www.tasict.com.au/service-directory/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why consider it\:** a particularly relevant option if you want a local specialist for workflow automation, Copilot Studio or AI-enabled business processes.

**Check first\:** client references, project examples, Microsoft partner credentials and the team's experience with production-scale Power Platform deployments.

[TasICT service directory](https://www.tasict.com.au/service-directory/)

## How I would choose between them

| Your requirement | First providers to approach |
|--------|--------|
| Local Hobart delivery and face-to-face workshops | ISW, UXC Eclipse, FutureAbility |
| Custom Power Apps and Power Automate workflows | Power Platform Experts, FutureAbility |
| Dynamics 365 integration or complex enterprise systems | UXC Eclipse, Barhead |
| Power Apps plus licensing, training and organisational change | Professional Advantage, Barhead |
| Power Platform and AI agents with Copilot Studio | FutureAbility; also ask Power Platform Experts about its current capability |


## What to verify before engaging a consultant

Microsoft expertise alone doesn't guarantee a successful implementation. I'd ask each shortlisted provider for\:

1. **Two relevant client references** — preferably Australian organisations with comparable workflows and complexity.
2. **Named delivery consultants** — and their current Microsoft certifications and relevant project experience.
3. **A demonstration of a similar solution** — particularly its security, error handling, maintainability and user experience.
4. **A governance plan** — including development and production environments, data-loss prevention policies, access controls and deployment practices.
5. **A clear commercial proposal** — covering licensing, discovery, development, testing, training, support and future enhancements.

You can also use Microsoft's official [Power Automate partner directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en/power-platform/products/power-automate/partners) to help validate partner credentials and relevant specialisations. [www.microsoft.com](https://www.microsoft.com/en/power-platform/products/power-automate/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My recommendation\:** For a genuinely local shortlist, start with **ISW and FutureAbility**\. Add **Power Platform Experts** for a specialist comparison and **UXC Eclipse** if your project involves Dynamics 365 or more complex enterprise integration. Confirm current delivery capacity and references before deciding.

One question that would help me narrow this to the best three: **what do you need the consultant to build or improve?** For example, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dynamics 365 integration, or an organisation-wide Power Platform rollout.
